dtype.ref: configs/models.yaml per model, resolved at submission (decided 11-04): float64 by default (k_SRME runs MACE in float64); PET-OAM-XL float32 (42-rotation symmetrizer 45 s -> 4.7 s per 64-atom force call on L40S, max force change 1.1e-5 eV/A; checked on c-BN in S0)

resources.nodelist.ref: execution only (does not change results); one node, e.g. 'a-a100-o-1' (A100-SXM4-80GB): the GPU partitions mix 40 and 80 GB cards and 512-atom supercells do not fit 48 GB (configs/models.yaml)

resources.exclude_nodes.ref: execution only (does not change results); comma-separated node names

resources.mem.ref: execution only (does not change results); host memory per job, Slurm --mem (e.g. '200G'); unset = the partition default per CPU. L3 needs >= 2x the FC4 estimate (MLIPFc4Params.max_fc4_gb)
